settings.title: Size & materials
settings.content:
The chain is 15.7" (40 cm) long with a 2" (5 cm) extender — easy to adjust.

Made of high-quality stainless steel; the gold version is plated with 18K gold.

Perfect for effortless everyday wear, with no special care needed.

settings.title: Shipping information
settings.content:
All orders are packed, prepared and shipped within 24–48 hours.

We offer fast worldwide shipping, and the usual delivery time is 4 to 7 days. Depending on where you live, your items may arrive a little earlier or later.

Every order comes with a tracking number, so you can follow your package every step of the way.

settings.title: Money-back guarantee
settings.content:
At Soraya Paris, your satisfaction is our top priority. Our goal is to give you an exceptional experience.

All our products come with a 30-day money-back guarantee. We'll do everything in our power to make sure your experience with Soraya Paris is a positive one!

settings.title: A Hug That Lasts Forever
settings.content: A stainless steel pendant, gold or silver plated. The symbol of the bond between a mother and her child.

settings.title: Everyday Comfort
settings.content: Adjustable length, waterproof and hypoallergenic. Made to be worn every day, without ever getting in the way.

settings.title: Perfect Gift Idea
settings.content: Choose an elegant, ready-to-give gift box. A refined present that combines style and durability to celebrate special moments.

settings.title: Eternal Bear Gift Box
settings.content: An adorable red bear holding an eternal rose and a gold necklace with intertwined hearts. A unique gift to express sincere, lasting love.

settings.content: This refined gift box pairs the beauty of red roses with the delicacy of a sparkling flower-shaped necklace. Presented in a luxurious case, it's perfect for expressing your love, your gratitude, or simply making her happy with style and emotion.

settings.content: This refined gift box pairs the timeless beauty of red roses with the sparkle of an elegant necklace. The perfect way to say "I love you" with elegance and emotion.

settings.title: How long is the chain?
settings.content: The chain is 15.7" (40 cm) long with a 2" (5 cm) extender, so it adjusts easily to any neck. Ideal for an elegant fit at the collarbone.

settings.title: Can I give it for a special occasion?
settings.content:
Any occasion. Birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Christmas, engagements, "just because I love you"...

The best gifts don't need an excuse. They come when you think of her. ❤️

settings.title: Can I shower with it?
settings.content: Yes. The chain is made of high-quality stainless steel with real 18K gold plating. It's waterproof, doesn't tarnish and keeps its shine — even when worn every day.

settings.title: What if my jewelry arrives damaged?
settings.content: If your jewelry was damaged during shipping, we'll send you a new one at our expense!

settings.title: What if I don't like it?
settings.content: Don't love it? Send us a message and we'll refund you, no questions asked!
